an4.273:1.1: [catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…] attanā ca micchādiṭṭhi hoti, parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, micchādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti, micchādiṭṭhiyā
an4.273:2.2: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato [yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.] [catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…] attanā ca sammādiṭṭhi hoti, parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti, sammādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti, sammādiṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. ime hi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato [yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.]
